title: Visit
metaTitle: Hours & Directions — Amber Inn, Eau Claire
metaDescription: Bar hours, kitchen hours, address, parking and directions to the Amber Inn Bar & Grill, 840 E Madison St, Eau Claire, WI 54703.

data.heading: Find us
data.intro: East Madison Street, a few blocks from the old Uniroyal plant. Same corner since 1881.
data.parking: Street parking on East Madison and the side streets. (Confirm lot details with the owner.)
accessibility: Street-level entrance — confirm step/ramp details with the owner before publishing.
Seven stools at the bar and booths along the wall.
Call ahead and we will hold a booth for a wheelchair user.
notes: Kids are welcome with an adult while the kitchen is open.
The bar is open later than the kitchen; both sets of hours are below.

data.heading: Hours
data.intro: Bar hours and kitchen hours are different. Both are here, and tonight's are live on the front page.

items.question: Where do I park?
items.answer: Street parking on East Madison Street and the side streets around it.

items.question: What time does the kitchen close?
items.answer: Kitchen hours are listed above, separately from bar hours, and tonight's close is live on the front page.

items.question: Can I bring kids?
items.answer: Yes, with an adult, while the kitchen is open.

items.question: Is the bar accessible?
items.answer: Call us at (715) 832-0568 and we will make it work — we can hold a booth.

items.question: Do you take reservations?
items.answer: No. Walk in. For a group, use the parties page and we will call you back.

data.heading: Bringing a group?
data.subtitle: Birthdays, Packer parties, the work crew.
